source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Mister Fantastic (archived 30 June 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Cosmic rays bombarded his body on the Fantastic Four's space flight, making his whole body stretchable.

abilities.name: Plasticity
abilities.detail: Can make his whole body malleable and reshape it in seconds; the change is reflexive, so even surprise machine-gun fire is absorbed.

abilities.name: Elongation
abilities.detail: Stretches his limbs, neck or torso to about 1,500 feet, and moves quickly by stretching to where he wants to go.

abilities.name: Shape changing
abilities.detail: Takes almost any shape he can picture: parachute, glider, trampoline, hammer fists, keys for locks, or flat as a sheet of paper.

abilities.name: Dense, elastic flesh
abilities.detail: Soaks up bullets and contains explosions by deforming, and can pack his mass into one spot, once putting 70 percent of it in a fist to hit Namor.

abilities.name: Super-genius intellect
abilities.detail: Called the smartest man on Earth, with a photographic memory and mastery of physics, engineering, chemistry, biology and travel to other dimensions.

abilities.name: Martial arts
abilities.detail: One of Earth's best judo experts and a master of body-striking techniques.

abilities.name: Sorcery
abilities.detail: Recently learned magic, reaching the Astral Plane and copying the abilities Doom used against Dormammu after studying that battle.

feats.text: Though weakened, he shielded the other heroes from a 150-billion-ton mountain dropped on them until the Hulk caught it; the strain knocked him out.
feats.where: Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars Vol 1 #4 (August 1984)

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars Vol 1 4

feats.text: Bulked his body up to the Thing's size and strength and hit the psychic entity Onslaught hard enough to stagger him.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Onslaught: Marvel Universe Vol 1 1

feats.text: Given the Beyonders' power by the Molecule Man, he worked with him and Franklin Richards to rebuild the destroyed Multiverse.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Secret Wars Vol 1 9

feats.text: Steered the Excelsior to a neutron star so its gravity would trap the pursuing Silver Surfer, escaping as the star destroyed their FTL engine.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: The Fantastic Four: First Steps

feats.text: Climbed onto Galactus above New York and pried open a socket on his back with a pole, leaking lava, until Galactus grabbed and stretched him.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: The Fantastic Four: First Steps

feats.text: As Galactus fell through the teleportation bridge, he leapt from a building onto the giant's hand, grabbed baby Franklin and jumped clear.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
